notices.short_title: B2300083 - 3M SCOTT Fire & Safety (Brand Spec) FDNY
notices.description:
Bid 2300083 - 3M SCOTT Fire & Safety (Brand Specific) FDNY - Renewal 1 of 1.

1-Year Renewal of originally a 3-Year Requirements Contract for a price list/catalog of BRAND SPECIFIC 3M Scott Fire & Safety Products. Sponsoring Agency is FDNY.
notices.plain: The Department of Citywide Administrative Services awarded Arbill Industries, Inc. a one-year renewal, worth $947,466, of a contract for brand-specific 3M Scott fire and safety products for the Fire Department of New York (FDNY).

notices.short_title: Laptops and Laptop Cases for FY27 DEM/Fleet
notices.plain: The Department of Citywide Administrative Services awarded Compulink Technologies Inc a $31,066 contract, without competition, for laptops and laptop cases for the FY27 DEM/Fleet program.

notices.agency_name: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
notices.description: DSS/ITS is requesting to utilize the two-year renewal option to the current contract with Prutech Solutions, Inc (DSS-ITS C-20230810-1; PIN: 24GPMIT14703). The original contract will expire on Dec. 31, 2026. The renewal period is from Jan. 1, 2027 to Dec. 31, 2028 in the amount of $632,000.00.
notices.plain: The Human Resources Administration awarded Prutech Solutions, Inc. a two-year renewal of its consulting services contract for management and operations, worth $632,000, covering Jan. 1, 2027, through Dec. 31, 2028.

notices.short_title: Project EC-WMC27 Citywide Emergency Reconstruction of Water Mains (PQL)
notices.plain: The Department of Design and Construction awarded Inter Contracting Corp a $13 million contract for citywide emergency reconstruction of water mains, chosen by competitive bid from a pre-qualified list of vendors.

notices.short_title: Deep Geotechnical and Environmental Land and Marine Borings to Support DOT and DEP Capital Projects, Citywide
notices.plain: The Department of Design and Construction awarded AARCO Environmental Services Corp a $4.9 million contract through competitive sealed bids for deep geotechnical and environmental land and marine borings supporting Department of Transportation and Department of Environmental Protection capital projects citywide.

notices.short_title: OGS BWS B5 Diesel Fuel (Westchester County) 7010538X
notices.plain: The Department of Environmental Protection awarded Sprague Operating Resources LLC a $70,000 contract for diesel fuel for its Westchester County operations, bought through a contract another government already holds.

notices.short_title: BWS - CRO-585 Maintenance & Repair of Hot Water Boilers & Boiler Appurtenances at Multiple DEP Facilities
notices.plain: The Department of Environmental Protection renewed its contract with Control Systems Services Inc. for maintenance and repair of hot water boilers and boiler equipment at multiple DEP facilities, in an amount of $956,837.

notices.short_title: 82627B0020-BEDC-CAT-475 High Level Outlet Install Gilboa Dam and Crest Gate Removal
notices.description: This Competitive Sealed Bid (RFx') is being released through PASSPort, New York Citys online procurement portal. Responses to this RFx should be submitted via PASSPort. To access the solicitation, vendors should visit the PASSPort Public Portal Navigator at https://passport.cityofnewyork.us/page.aspx/en/rfp/request_browse_public. This will take you to the Public Portal of all procurements in the PASSPort system. To quickly locate the RFx, insert the EPIN 82627B0020 into the Keywords search field. If you need assistance submitting a response, please contact MOCS Service Desk: mocssupport.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/8
notices.plain: The Department of Environmental Protection is seeking sealed bids, due Dec. 29, 2026, for construction work to install a high-level outlet and remove crest gates at the Gilboa Dam, with bids submitted through the city's PASSPort portal.

notices.short_title: Repair, Resurfacing and Replacement of Gym flooring at St. Marys Recreation Center
notices.plain: The Department of Parks and Recreation awarded Hi Tech Contractors Corp a $34,500 contract to repair, resurface and replace gym flooring at St. Marys Recreation Center, using a small purchase from a certified minority- or women-owned business made without competition.

notices.description: Pursuant to Section 3-05 of the NYC Procurement Policy Board Rules, it is the intent of the New York City Police Department (NYPD) to enter into sole source negotiations with ITSA Solutions, LLC d/b/a Barnacle Parking Enforcement with the expectation that ITSA Solutions, LLC will be awarded a five year contract with three, 3-Year renewal options for the Lease of Barnacle Vehicle Immobilization devices. The basis of this determination is that ITSA Solutions, LLC is the sole provider and uniquely qualified to provide these specialized services for NYPDs Traffic Enforcement Division and other Bureaus. Any vendor besides ITSA Solutions, LLC that believes it can provide these services is invited to do so.  To respond in PASSPort, please upload an Expression of Interest in the Documents Submission Section of the Manage Responses tab.  If you have questions about the details of the RFx, please submit them through the Discussion with Buyer tab.
notices.plain: The New York City Police Department intends to negotiate a sole source five-year lease of Barnacle vehicle immobilization devices with ITSA Solutions, LLC, with three three-year renewal options, and other vendors may respond by Nov. 19, 2026.

notices.description:
This is a notice that NYC Aging is seeking comments from the public about the proposed contract below.  

Contract Type: General Contract (CT1)

Scope of Services: Comprehensive management, maintenance, regulatory compliance, training, certification, and readiness services for approximately 450 AED units located at NYC Aging-funded community-based organizations across the five boroughs.

Term: November 1, 2026, through June 30, 2029

E-PIN: 12527W0002001

Contractor: Emergency Skills, Inc.
notices.plain: The Department for the Aging is seeking public comment on a proposed contract with Emergency Skills, Inc. to manage, maintain, and certify about 450 automated external defibrillators (AEDs) at community organizations it funds across the five boroughs, running from Nov. 1, 2026, through June 30, 2029.

notices.short_title: Laboratory Information Systems (LIS) Support and Maintenance
notices.description:
This is a notice that the NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene is seeking comments from the public about the proposed contract below. 

 

Contract Type: New Contract

Contractor: Oracle America Inc.

Contractor Address: 500 Oracle Parkway, Redwood Shores, CA, 94065

Scope of Services: To provide system access and maintenance of NYC DOHMH Public Health Laboratorys (PHL) Laboratory Information Systems (LIS) operations from order capture through specimen processing, results validation, regulatory reporting, and data archiving.

Maximum Value: $15,000,000.00
notices.plain: The Department of Health and Mental Hygiene is seeking public comment on a proposed new $15 million contract with Oracle America Inc. to maintain and provide access to the Public Health Laboratory's laboratory information system, which handles specimen processing, results and regulatory reporting, and data archiving.

notices.description:
This is a notice that the NYC Office of Technology & Innovation is seeking comments from the public about the proposed contract below.

Contract Type: CT1

Contractor: Portland Williams LLC

Contractor Address: 75 N Central Avenue, Suite 105, Elmsford, NY 10523

Scope of Services: Continued software maintenance, technical support hotline access, and extended hardware warranty services for the VIAVI Optical Network Monitoring System (ONMS). The renewal supports uninterrupted monitoring of New York City's fiber infrastructure.

notices.plain: The Department of Information Technology and Telecommunications seeks comment on a proposed renewal of Portland Williams LLC's contract for software maintenance, technical support and hardware warranties for the VIAVI network monitoring system.

notices.short_title: Teachers Retirement System of the City of New York Monthly Board Meeting
notices.description:
Please be advised that the next Board Meeting of the Teachers Retirement System of the City of New York (TRS) has been scheduled for Thursday, November 19, 2026, at 3:30 p.m.

The meeting will be held at the Teachers Retirement System, 55 Water Street, 16th Floor, Boardroom, New York, NY 10041. The meeting is open to the public. However, portions of the meeting, where permitted by law, may be held in executive session.

The remote Zoom meeting link, meeting ID, and phone number will be available approximately one hour before the start of the meeting at:

https://www.trsnyc.org/memberportal/About-Us/our…
notices.plain: The Teachers' Retirement System's monthly board meeting is set for Nov. 19, 2026, at 3:30 p.m. at its 55 Water Street boardroom in Manhattan, and it is open to the public, though parts may be held in executive session.

notices.description:
Notice of Intent to Renew or Amend Contract(s) Not Included in FY2027 Annual Contracting Plan and Schedule

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor will be entering into the following renewal(s)/amendment(s)) of (a) contract(s) not included in the FY 2027 Annual Contracting Plan and Schedule that is published pursuant to New York City Charter § 312(a): 

Agency: New York City Police Department
Vendor: Intergraph Corporation 
Description of Services to be Provided: 911 Computer Aided Dispatch System
Anticipated Procurement Method:  Amendment
Anticipated New Start Date: 09/01/2025
Anticipated New End Date: 8/31/2030
Anticipated Modification to Scope: Software Upgrade
Reason for Renewal/ Amendment: Increase to contract value and statement of work addition.
Job Titles:  None
Headcount: 0
notices.plain: The New York City Police Department plans to amend its contract with Intergraph Corporation for its 911 computer-aided dispatch system, adding a software upgrade and increasing the contract value, with a new term running from Sept. 1, 2025, through Aug. 31, 2030.

notices.short_title: NOTICE OF FILING - 108-14 ASTORIA BOULEVARD, QUEENS
notices.description:
NOTICE OF FILING

 

Pursuant to §1731 of the New York Public Authorities Law, notice has been filed for the proposed site selection of all or portions of Block 1703, Lot(s) 86, 87, 93, 94, 97-99 and any other nearby sites for the construction of a new school facility. The NYC Department of Education (DOE) is proposing a facility designed for an approximately 676-seat high school in Queens.

The proposed site is located at 108-14 Astoria Boule…
notices.plain: The School Construction Authority has filed notice of a proposed site, Block 1703, Lots 86, 87, 93, 94 and 97-99 at 108-14 Astoria Boulevard in Queens, for a new high school of about 676 seats that the Department of Education proposes.
